name: HitFile
description: Resolves HitFile links as a guest through the site's captcha and countdown, or with an account.

account.secret_hint: The password of the HitFile account named above. rDownloader signs in itself and keeps the session; the password only ever reaches app.hitfile.net. Without an account, links are downloaded as a guest, with the site's captcha and countdown.
account.username_hint: The e-mail address the HitFile account signs in with.

codes.hitfile.account_banned: HitFile reports this account as banned
codes.hitfile.account_missing: HitFile account or password is missing
codes.hitfile.folder_not_file: This HitFile link is a folder; add the files it contains instead
codes.hitfile.free_limit_reached: HitFile free download limit reached for this IP address; another download is possible in {wait_seconds}s
codes.hitfile.login_captcha: HitFile did not accept the sign-in's captcha answer; it is retried later
codes.hitfile.login_failed: HitFile rejected the account's e-mail address or password
codes.hitfile.no_direct_link: HitFile did not hand out a download link
codes.hitfile.not_signed_in: HitFile refused the request as not signed in
codes.hitfile.premium_limit_reached: HitFile handed out no download link to the premium account; the daily limit may be reached
codes.hitfile.premium_only: HitFile offers this file to premium accounts only
codes.hitfile.rate_limited: HitFile rate limit reached; the request is retried later
